items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He can drum. So he came by, and he was with Fate Marable's band.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, Singleton. Said his name is Singleton. He can drum. So he came by, and he was with Fate Marable's band.
Well, how did you get him away from Fate Marible?
Oh, well, he went back to New Orleans.
